subject: Quantitative Aptitude
question: A person buys an article for ₹800 and sells it for ₹1000. What is the profit percentage?
solution: Profit = 1000 - 800 = 200. Profit % = (Profit / Cost Price) * 100 = (200 / 800) * 100 = 25%. Topic (Profit and Loss) is in the SSC CGL syllabus. Source: https://ssc.gov.in/api/assets/uploads/master-data/Syllabus/Syllabus_CGL_2024.pdf
author: Hermes
